text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove claims victory in the showdown
between the "Out of this World Escape Artist" and the "Empress"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHH...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Suzuka was so close~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah... But I wonder why... I just couldn't take my eyes off her...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...
I couldn't catch up...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“...True, I crossed the finish line first in the race.
However—”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It was far from a satisfying result...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It is true that you crossed the finish line behind me.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —The gazes and fervent passion of the audience and the Umamusume held you captive, refusing to let go...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I couldn't... 'surpass' you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Silence Suzuka's sprint at the Takarazuka Kinen
was overwhelmingly powerful, and so free."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes were captivated, utterly overwhelmed—
and Air Groove could keenly sense it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just don't give me any pity, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will do what I must do.
So you do what you need to do, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still... once I become an Umamusume
worthy of being called the 'Empress'—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes,
please let me challenge you again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meeting Air Groove's passionate gaze,
she responded with a deep nod of her own.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, surely...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and Silence Suzuka exchanged a firm handshake, vowing to race each other again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think I'll be able to forget today...
for quite a while."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
During the race,
I could hear Air Groove's heartbeat.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Her passion... was burning right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: “But... that's exactly why I refused to give up the lead...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if the "Empress's" flames had spread to her,
her eyes were glowing with a quiet, burning intensity.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I... want to get faster. Much, much faster.
choice_data_list: First, let's make it through the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, thank you very much.
Good night, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing her off into the dorm,
I turned around to head home, only to—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Ngaaaah! So frustrating!
Curse you, Suzuka-senpai~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, it's already nighttime,
so no shouting, okay~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still... I was just in the spectator stands, you know!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And Suzuka-senpai didn't even finish in 1st place!
Yet to be overwhelmed like that anyway!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To make me think... "I can't win"~?!
What a humiliation! Pure humiliation, humiliation, humiliation~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: At this rate... "world's strongest" is just a pipe dream...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ngaaaaaah! Go for it, El!
Fight, El! Run, El~~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Geez, that's why I said no loud voices~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, though.
She truly was like a tempest... wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the curtains were about to rise on yet another battle.
